topography.project_purpose: NFT Marketplace. Structurally: 163 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 13 ERC20 tokens, 19 ERC721 NFTs, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 51 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc721burnable, erc165). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
